# Chart Reader by Asendify

> Chart Reader (https://charts.asendify.co) is an educational tool that explains screenshots of trading charts (stocks, crypto, forex, indices, commodities) in plain English. It is not financial advice: it never tells anyone to buy or sell. Made by Asendify.

## Key facts
- Each read covers: trend, market structure, key support and resistance zones read from the price axis, notable patterns, volume and indicator notes when visible, 2-3 conditional scenarios ("if price does X, traders often watch Y") with invalidation levels, position-size arithmetic from the user's own account size and risk % per trade (pure arithmetic), and what would change the picture.
- Every result carries this notice: educational analysis only, not financial advice, no guarantee of accuracy, trading carries a high risk of losing money.
- Price: 100 chart reads for £435 (£300 + 45% service fee of £135). One-time payment through PayPal. Reads never expire. Nothing is free (no free trial or free reads).
- Only successful reads use a credit: if the image is not a chart, or the reader fails, the read is given back automatically.
- Accounts: email plus one-time sign-in links (no passwords). Results are saved in the user's history.
- Screenshots are stored privately and deleted automatically after 30 days; written results are kept.
- How it works: an AI vision model reads the screenshot and writes the explanation to a fixed structure; it can misread blurry charts or cut-off price axes.
- Policies (payments and refunds): https://www.asendify.co/policies/
